item.title: Editorial Work in an Archive
item.description: Practise choosing precise terms for representing archival documents, quotations and scans. Use context to distinguish what an editor adds, rewrites, conceals, corrects or reproduces.

children.definition: To add notes to a text or image to explain or comment on specific details.
children.example: The curator annotated the estate map with notes explaining the symbols beside each building.

children.definition: To express the meaning of a passage in different words.
children.example: For the exhibition label, the editor paraphrased the lease clause as a requirement to pay rent every three months.

children.definition: To remove or conceal sensitive information in a document before making it available to others.
children.example: Before sharing the complaint file, the archivist redacted the witness’s home address from the public copy.
children.translation_ru: удалять или скрывать закрытые сведения в документе перед его передачей или публикацией
children.translation_uz: hujjatni boshqalarga taqdim etishdan oldin oshkor etilmasligi kerak boʻlgan maʼlumotlarni olib tashlamoq yoki yashirmoq

children.definition: To convert handwritten or printed material into typed text while preserving its wording.
children.example: A volunteer transcribed the ship’s log, preserving the captain’s spelling and punctuation.
children.translation_ru: набирать рукописный или печатный текст с сохранением его формулировок

children.definition: The identification of the person or organisation known or believed to have created a work or made a statement.
children.example: The editor marked the attribution of the unsigned poem to the printer’s daughter as tentative.
children.translation_ru: указание на предполагаемого или установленного автора произведения либо высказывания
children.translation_uz: asar muallifi yoki gapni kim aytganini aniqlash yoki koʻrsatish

children.definition: A published notice that identifies and corrects an error in a publication.
children.example: The journal issued an erratum giving the correct date for the letter reproduced in its previous issue.
children.translation_ru: опубликованное уведомление об ошибке в издании с указанием правильного варианта
children.translation_uz: nashrda yoʻl qoʻyilgan xato va uning tuzatishi haqida eʼlon

children.definition: To correct a suspected error in a text when preparing an edition, typically on the basis of textual evidence.
children.example: Because the same payment appears as ‘fifteen shillings’ in two surviving copies, the editor emended ‘fifty’ to ‘fifteen’ in the new edition.
children.translation_ru: исправлять при подготовке издания предполагаемую ошибку в тексте, обычно с опорой на текстологические данные
children.translation_uz: nashrga tayyorlashda matnning xato deb topilgan oʻrnini, odatda boshqa nusxalar yoki matndagi dalillarga tayanib, tuzatmoq

children.definition: A reproduction that closely preserves the visual appearance of an original document or image.
children.example: The reading room supplied a full-size facsimile of the deed showing the original layout and the impression of its seal.

children.definition: The history of where an item or collection came from and who owned it or kept it.
children.example: A donor’s inventory helped establish the provenance of the photographs by recording their transfer from the family to the museum.
children.translation_ru: история происхождения предмета или коллекции и того, кому они принадлежали или у кого хранились
children.translation_uz: buyum yoki toʻplamning kelib chiqishi, kimlarga tegishli boʻlgani va kimlar qoʻlida saqlangani tarixi

children.definition: Impossible to read because the letters or other marks cannot be made out.
children.example: A crease in the scanned telegram made the final word illegible.

children.definition: Using exactly the same words as the original.
children.example: The report quoted the clerk’s reply verbatim, including the phrase ‘by the usual route’.

children.definition: To shorten a work by removing parts while retaining its main content.
children.example: To fit the memoir into a single volume, the editor abridged it by cutting several chapters on the author’s school years.
children.translation_ru: сокращать произведение, сохраняя его основное содержание
children.translation_uz: asarning asosiy mazmunini saqlagan holda uni qisqartirmoq

children.definition: To compare copies or versions of a text systematically in order to identify differences.
children.example: The researcher collated three drafts of the speech and recorded which paragraphs each version omitted.
children.translation_uz: farqlarini aniqlash uchun matn nusxalari yoki variantlarini sinchiklab solishtirmoq

children.definition: To take the place of an earlier version or document as the one currently in use.
children.example: The signed inventory superseded the provisional list as the official record of the deposit.
children.translation_ru: вступать в силу взамен прежнего документа или редакции
children.translation_uz: avvalgi hujjat yoki talqin oʻrnini egallab, amaldagi hujjatga yoki talqinga aylanmoq
